title: Two-step reaction
hints: Place C on the product side.
Two B are needed to cancel.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Reverse and double step 2, giving $\ce{2B -> 2C}$ and $+70$ kJ. Add $90+70=160$ kJ.
statement:
Step 1 is $\ce{A -> 2B}$ with $\Delta H=+90$ kJ. Step 2 is $\ce{C -> B}$ with $\Delta H=-35$ kJ. Find $\Delta H$ for $\ce{A -> 2C}$.

[_]{a}

explanations: Reversal and doubling are both included.
The sign of step 2 was kept.
Step 2 was reversed but used only once.
